name: The Pit Stop
description: The aftershow for RuPaul's Drag Race and RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars. The show involves two people (usually two previous competitors from Drag Race) who discuss the events of the episode.

videos.title: Trixie Mattel & Jaymes Mansfield Recap Remix!
videos.overview: Did you just say wig? 🎀 ‪Trixie Mattel‬ and hair extraordinaire ‪Jaymes Mansfield get into the first half of Drag Race Season 16 in this extra-special episode of The Pit Stop – brought to you by göt2b's Color-Remix! 🌈 💆‍♀

videos.title: Trixie Mattel & Jaymes Mansfield: The Shequel!

Monét X Change & Trinity The Tuck Roll The Dice
videos.overview: It’s an All Stars 4 reunion when Trinity The Tuck joins her twinner, brand-new host Monét X Change, at The Pit Stop to talk all things Season 14! Join these legends for the only official recap series for RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14.

videos.title: Monét X Change & Gottmik Get It
videos.overview: Gagatronda! Season 13 Finalist Gottmik crashes The Pit Stop, joining host Monét X Change to break down the second premiere of the brand-new season! It’s about to get GORGE on the only official recap series for RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14.

videos.title: Monét X Change & Violet Chachki Ball Out
videos.overview: Oh yes. Season 7 Winner and Fashion Goddess Violet Chachki is BACK for the Ball, and joining Monét X Change at The Pit Stop to kikiana about all things Season 14. This truly is the episode you’ve been waiting for of the only official recap series of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14!

videos.title: Monét X Change & Laganja Estranja Tease Us
videos.overview: Is it really a season of The Pit Stop if Laganja Estranja doesn’t stop by? The iconic Laganja joins Monét X Change at The Pit Stop to get loud for the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14! Natch.

videos.title: Monét X Change & Alaska Save Us All
videos.overview: It’s legends only when former host and All Stars 2 stunosha Alaska returns to The Pit Stop! Alaska joins Monét X Change to dial in for the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14! Are you red… E?

videos.title: Monét X Change & Gigi Goode in Prime Time
videos.overview: Season 12 Design Virtuosa Gigi Goode joins Monét X Change to journey out of the box, and doll out about the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14. Snap a lash and pull up to The Pit Stop!

videos.title: Monét X Change & Adore Delano Get Soapy
videos.overview: Do you smell that? As The Daytona Wind breaks, icon Adore Delano joins Monét X Change to get twisted, and recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14. Punk Rock Princesses only at The Pit Stop, please!

videos.title: Monét X Change & Katya Go Retro!
videos.overview: Katya joins Monét X Change on The Pit Stop to recap the latest episode from RuPaul's Drag Race, Season 14.

videos.title: Monét X Change & Brooke Lynn Hytes Talk Menzeses!
videos.overview: The Pit Stop goes to Brooklyn- er, Brooke Lynn! Gird your loins, Season 11 finalist and Canadian Host Extraordinaire Brooke Lynn Hytes joins Monét X Change to breakdown the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14. And just like that, as winter turns to spring, the Queen of the North ascends upon The Pit Stop for one final blast!

videos.title: Monét X Change & Bianca Del Rio Sip N’ Snatch
videos.overview: It’s time to recap Snatch Game on #ThePitStop with Monét X Change and extra special guest Bianca Del Rio! From the bubly mini challenge to the Snatch Game, these Queens got you covered on the only official RuPaul’s Drag Race recap show!

videos.title: Monét X Change & Silky Ganache Wanna LaLa
videos.overview: Let’s get ready to Rumble! It’s time for a Lip Sync Smackdown LaLaPaRuZa, which means All Stars 6 Assassin Silky Nutmeg Ganache is joining Monét X Change to break down the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14 ONLY on The Pit Stop. They’re leaving no crumbs on the stage as the queens face off with everything on the line!

videos.title: Monét X Change & Pangina Heals Come What May
videos.overview: Ready for Thai Tea? ‘Cause Pangina Heals is at The Pit Stop! Pangina journeys to the Moulin Ru with Monét X Change where they judge Rusical Week, and break down everything RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14. Mirror Mirror on the wall, who’s the shadiest of them all?

videos.title: Monét X Change & A’Keria C. Davenport Fire It Up
videos.overview: You are cordially invited to the Official Recap of the Roast of Ross Mathews featuring Caftan Enthusiast A’Keria C. Davenport and Host Extraordinaire Monét X Change. Watch as they chat about all of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14, and aim to answer the time-old question: where is the bawdy!?

videos.title: Monét X Change & Bob the Drag Queen On The Catwalk
videos.overview: It’s the episode you all have been waiting for! The end of the season is near, and a little Sibling Rivalry is crashing The Pit Stop. Bob the Drag Queen joins Monét X Change to recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14. The claws are coming out on the Catwalk!

videos.title: Monét X Change & Naomi Smalls Crown A Winner
videos.overview: Go brush your hair because we have a winner, baby! America’s Next Drag Superstar has been crowned, and icon Naomi Smalls is joining Monét X Change to cash in on the Grand Finale of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 14.

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen & Nicole Byer Are Crowning
videos.overview: The Gay Gods have listened! Bob the Drag Queen returns to The Pit Stop to host a brand-new season of the official recap series of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Joining Bob is comedy legend and Drag Race favorite, Nicole Byer! Watch as Bob and Nicole rucap the premiere episode, and kick-off a truly legendary season!

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen And Eureka O’Hara Are Here!
videos.overview: Get snatched away with All-Star Eureka O’Hara and Host Bob the Drag Queen, as the duo recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Pull up to The Pit Stop because this road-tripping twosome are talking Snatch Game and gagging over pleather, as they recap the legendary All Winners season… GURL!

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen And Katya Are Balling!
videos.overview: We come to this place for magic. That indescribable feeling we get when Katya returns to The Pit Stop, joining Host Bob the Drag Queen to go somewhere we’ve never been before. Watch Bob and Katya recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Somehow, heartbreak feels good in a place like this.

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen & Naysha Lopez Are Serving!
videos.overview: Did somebody mention ART? It’s a Season 8 reunion when Naysha Lopez makes her Pit Stop debut, and joins Bob the Drag Queen to recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. This episode of The Pit Stop serves: fairytale justice, glamour, and Continental realness hunny.

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen & Manila Luzon Graduate!
videos.overview: Gag. Summer is here, and we’re feeling Fineapple Couture when Pit Stop favorite Manila Luzon returns, joining Bob the Drag Queen to spill on All Winners, baby! Watch Bob and Manila break down the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Did somebody call for an icon?

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen & Derrick Barry
videos.overview: Oops, we did it again. Gimme more when Derrick Barry breaks the ice and joins the circus with Bob the Drag Queen at The Pit Stop! We’re feeling both lucky and stronger as Bob and Derrick work bitch and wanna go to the slumber party to recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Do you wanna come over?

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen & Willow Pill Win!
videos.overview: It’s Winners Only when Miss Current Reining, Willow Pill, joins Bob the Drag Queen on a Legendary episode of The Pit Stop! Watch Bob and Willow recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. These queens just want money, jewelry and hot dogs!

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen & Peppermint!
videos.overview: Nothing quite says Christmas in July better than a piping hot mug of Peppermint tea! It’s the fashion episode you’ve been waiting for when the legendary Peppermint - Miss Mint, if you’re nasty - reunites with Bob the Drag Queen at The Pit Stop to spill on the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Come for the fashion, stay for the holiday chaos!

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen and Priyanka Live!
videos.overview: Oh Cana-DO! Queen Priyanka is coming on through, and coming for YOU. Watch legendary winners Priyanka and host Bob the Drag Queen kiki at The Pit Stop and recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. What’s her name? Peronka!

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen and Joel Kim Booster!
videos.overview: Strap in and Light up for a very special episode of The Pit Stop when Comedian Joel Kim Booster stops by and breaks down the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7 with host Bob the Drag Queen. We’re getting this roast a’cookin, and no one is safe!

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen And Vanjie React!
videos.overview: Oh yes, it’s getting WILD at The Pit Stop as All Winners inches closer to its epic finale! The incomparable Vanessa Vanjie Mateo sits down with Bob the Drag Queen and recaps the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Trend alert: chaos.

videos.title: Bob The Drag Queen And Thorgy Thor Go In!
videos.overview: Buckle up for The Pit Stop episode you’ve been waiting for! The one and only Thorgy Thor reunites with her Season 8 sister Bob the Drag Queen, and recaps the FINALE episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 7. Who will be the Queen Of All Queens!?

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio, Jinkx & BenDeLaCrene Recap The Premiere
Bianca Del Rio & Scarlet Envy Are The Drama!
videos.overview: All-Star beauty Scarlet Envy brings debut drama to The Pit Stop, when she sits down with host supreme Bianca Del Rio to break down the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. The queens are ascending to the afterlife and no one is safe!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Adore Delano Party!
videos.overview: Season 6 bestie Bianca Del Rio to break down the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. Are these Drag Race icons, or Judge Judy and Anna Nicole Smith? You decide!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Detox Deliver Fashion!
videos.overview: Nurse! Drag Race deity Detox crashes The Pit Stop to talk fashion and everything Season 15 with host extraordinaire Bianca Del Rio. Watch as this iconic duo recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15 and break down all the looks. They have had it, officially!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Mariah Are Golden!
videos.overview: The face herself, Mariah Balenciaga, joins host Bianca Del Rio at The Pit Stop to recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. Thank YOU for being a friend!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Kandy “The Pit Stop” Muse!
videos.overview: The producer is here! Yes bitch, Kandy Muse finally makes her Pit Stop debut with host Bianca Del Rio to recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. This Valentine’s Day, treat yourself to some Kandy.

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Brooke Lynn Hytes Judge!
videos.overview: Grab the popcorn and get tosey, er- COZY, for the Season 15 Lip Sync LaLaPaRuZa Smackdown with Bianca Del Rio and special guest Brooke Lynn Hytes! Watch as this duo breaks down the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. Sorry, not sorry!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Alyssa Edwards Forever!
Bianca Del Rio & Jaida Essence Hall Cuff It!
videos.overview: Look over here! Category is winner winner baby, when the essence of beauty, Jaida Essence Hall, joins host Bianca Del Rio for a brand-new episode of The Pit Stop! Watch as Bianca and Jaida recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. Calm down, Beyoncé.

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Plastique Tiara Spill!
videos.overview: Queen of TikTok Plastique Tiara came to sip, slay, and spill on last night's Bubly Comedy Festival! 🤩 Watch as she and host Bianca Del Rio get into it on #ThePitStop! #ad

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Laganja Estranja Reunite!
videos.overview: Mawma, it’s the ru-union you’ve been waiting for! Laganja Estranja is back at The Pit Stop, together with Bianca Del Rio, and this is their moment! Watch as these two Season 6 icons recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. Yes gawd!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Naomi Smalls Pose!
videos.overview: Life’s not fair. The Queen of the Makeover Challenge, goddess Naomi Smalls, joins host Bianca Del Rio to recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. Brush your hair bitch, and pull up to The Pit Stop!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Raja Cut Up!
videos.overview: Hark! Raja, the Queen of She Done Already Done Had Herses returns to The Pit Stop, joining host Bianca Del Rio to recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race Season 15. Celebrate this April Fool’s Extravaganza, because it’s a Shoot!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Monét X Change Celebrate!
videos.overview: Soak it up! 🧽 Monét X Change popped by #thepitstop to sip and spill on last night's Grand Finale with Bianca Del Rio! 👑

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Alaska Get All-Started!
videos.overview: Back, back, back again! Join host Bianca Del Rio and extra-special guest Alaska, as they recap the premiere episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 8! The Fame Games have officially begun. R-U ready for it?

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Kylie Sonique Love Squad Up!
videos.overview: LIVE from The Pit Stop, it’s Kylie Sonique Live- er, Love! Join winners Kylie and Bianca Del Rio as they recap the latest episode of RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars 8. The Suicide Squad could never!

videos.title: Bianca Del Rio & Sugar & Spice Together!
videos.overview: Bianca Del Rio heads to the supermarket, straight for the SUGAR AND SPICE aisle! Yes gawd, the twins have trotted onto The Pit Stop set, and no one is safe.
